messages.content:
Project: Mission Rank Academy

Act as a professional full-stack web developer, UI/UX designer, and educational technology expert.

Build a modern, professional, fully responsive educational website named MISSION RANK ACADEMY.

The platform should look and function like a premium online learning platform for students preparing for school examinations and competitive examinations such as JEE, NEET, CUET, and other entrance exams.

1. Website Design

- Modern, premium, attractive educational UI.
- Professional color combination: Navy Blue, White, and Gold.
- Fully responsive for mobile, tablet, laptop, and desktop.
- Smooth animations and transitions.
- Beautiful dashboard with interactive cards.
- Professional typography and icons.
- Easy navigation and user-friendly interface.

2. Homepage

Create an attractive landing page containing:

- Mission Rank Academy logo.
- Navigation bar.
- Home, Courses, Live Classes, Recorded Classes, Notes, Tests, About Us, Contact.
- Hero section with headline: "Your Mission. Your Rank. Your Future."
- Short introduction about the academy.
- Explore Courses button.
- Join Now button.
- Featured courses.
- Popular teachers section.
- Student achievements and testimonials.
- Statistics showing students enrolled, courses available, and successful students.
- Footer with social media links.

3. Student Authentication

Create a complete authentication system:

- Student registration.
- Login and logout.
- Forgot password.
- Email or phone authentication.
- Student profile.
- Secure password handling.
- Role-based access for students, teachers, and administrators.

4. Student Dashboard

After login, students should see:

- Welcome message.
- Enrolled courses.
- Learning progress.
- Upcoming live classes.
- Recently uploaded lectures.
- Downloaded notes.
- Upcoming tests.
- Test results.
- Notifications.
- Personal profile.

5. Courses Section

Create a complete course management system:

- Class 9, 10, 11, and 12 courses.
- Science, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, and Computer Science.
- JEE preparation.
- NEET preparation.
- CUET preparation.
- Course descriptions.
- Teacher information.
- Course pricing.
- Enroll Now button.
- Course progress tracking.

6. Live Classes

Implement:

- Live class schedule.
- Join Live Class button.
- Upcoming class notifications.
- Teacher-wise live sessions.
- Live class links.
- Previous class recordings.

7. Recorded Classes

- Video lecture library.
- Subject-wise video organization.
- Chapter-wise lectures.
- Video progress tracking.
- Continue Watching feature.
- Restricted access for enrolled students.

8. Study Materials and Notes

- PDF notes.
- Chapter-wise study materials.
- Download notes option.
- Previous year question papers.
- Important questions.
- Sample papers.
- Organize everything by class and subject.

9. Online Test System

Build an interactive examination platform:

- Multiple-choice questions.
- Timed examinations.
- Automatic evaluation.
- Negative marking support.
- Instant results.
- Detailed solutions.
- Leaderboard.
- Performance analysis.
- Subject-wise test reports.

10. Admin Dashboard

Create a powerful admin panel where the administrator can:

- Add, edit, and delete courses.
- Upload video lectures.
- Upload PDF notes.
- Schedule live classes.
- Create online tests.
- Add and manage questions.
- Manage student accounts.
- Manage teacher accounts.
- View enrollment statistics.
- Manage payments.
- Send notifications.
- Monitor student performance.

11. Teacher Dashboard

Teachers should be able to:

- Manage their courses.
- Upload lectures.
- Upload study materials.
- Schedule live classes.
- Create tests and assignments.
- View student performance.

12. Payment System

- Course purchasing.
- Online payment integration.
- Payment history.
- Enrollment confirmation.
- Support for Indian payment methods such as UPI, cards, and net banking through a suitable payment gateway.

13. Additional Features

- Search courses.
- Contact and support page.
- Frequently asked questions.
- Student announcements.
- Dark mode.
- Mobile-friendly navigation.
- SEO optimization.
- Fast loading speed.
- Secure database.
- Automatic backups.

14. Technology Stack

Use a modern and scalable technology stack:

- Frontend: React.js or Next.js.
- Styling: Tailwind CSS.
- Backend: Node.js or Supabase.
- Database: PostgreSQL.
- Authentication: Supabase Auth.
- Video hosting: Secure video hosting service.
- File storage: Supabase Storage.
- Payment gateway: Razorpay.

15. Important Development Instructions

- Build a fully functional website, not just a static design.
- Connect frontend components to a working backend.
- Make all buttons and navigation links functional.
- Implement proper authentication and authorization.
- Protect paid course content.
- Create separate dashboards for students, teachers, and administrators.
- Use reusable components and clean code.
- Add sample data for initial testing.
- Never expose secret API keys in frontend code.

Final Goal:

Create a premium educational platform called MISSION RANK ACADEMY that provides students with everything they need to learn, practice, take examinations, track progress, and achieve their academic goals.
